{'index': 0, 'translation': "Apple's autumn iPhone launch event is expected to take on a different look this year. Word on the street is that only flagship models will be unveiled, rather than the usual quartet of similar devices. Reports say September will bring three high-end models: the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, and Apple's first foldable phone, widely expected to be called the iPhone Ultra."}

{'index': 1, 'translation': 'Which of the three premium iPhones should you pick?'}

{'index': 2, 'translation': 'If you prefer a traditional design, the iPhone 18 Pro is rumoured to feature a smaller Dynamic Island, a 2nm A20 Pro chip, an Apple C2 modem, longer battery life, and significant camera upgrades. The larger Pro Max version, with its bigger screen, may sell itself on a larger battery while retaining the classic iPhone design and triple-lens camera system.'}

{'index': 3, 'translation': "The rumoured iPhone Ultra is this year's most groundbreaking option: a book-style foldable with an approximately 5.5-inch outer display and a 7.8-inch inner display, housed in a slim titanium body, with Touch ID replacing Face ID and just two rear cameras. Reports suggest the screen has no visible crease, and performance matches the A20 Pro — but the starting price is expected to reach US$2,000 or more."}

{'index': 4, 'translation': 'If the rumours are true, which new iPhone are you planning to buy? Join our poll and share your thoughts in the comments!'}

{'index': 5, 'translation': 'Get the most out of your Apple products'}
